correctness.rationale: Direct Gaussian conditional fourth moments of L_k^T L_k close on E(tr M)^2 and E tr(M²), giving transfer [[1,2/(nr)],[1/r,(1+1/r)/n]]. The final independent Gaussian core yields n^d(U+2V/n-1) Frobenius-normalized risk. Dominant eigenvalue expands as log lambda+=2/((n-1)r²)+O(r^-3), giving the sharp r~sqrt(d) transition; fixed-d large-n expansion and total-variance lower bound give the second critical scale. Independent exact kernel-summation checks of the previously known all-coordinate formula matched values 7,45/2,218/9, and independent direct random TT contractions corroborated the first two up to sampling error.
residual_risks: Finite samples and rational cases do not prove all-parameter identities; validity supported by Gaussian conditional algebra.

evidence: Previously published Nov 2 general TT coordinate fourth-moment kernel: E[omega_I²omega_J²]=(1+2/r)^(d-1) prod_g(1+2((r-1)/(r+2))^g)/3 for I != J, diagonal 3(1+2/r)^(d-1).
That source explicitly gives Var H(A)=sum_{I,J} a_I a_J(K(I,J)-1) for arbitrary diagonal A. Taking A=I_{n^d} gives complete identity variance for every n,d,r.
Independent direct exact kernel sum reproduced normalized identity risks 7 (n,d,r=2,2,2), 45/2 (2,3,2), 218/9 (3,3,3), identical to assigned transfer recursion.

originality.rationale: A previously published general squared-coordinate fourth-moment covariance kernel for precisely the SAME Gaussian TT distribution provides an exact variance formula for EVERY diagonal matrix. Setting A=I gives the entire claimed exact identity moment for ALL n,d,r, not merely the rank-one case. The square-root-rank limit is a direct Perron/transfer asymptotic of this preexisting complete kernel. The result is mathematically covered as a special case/corollary even though the earlier paper emphasized coordinate-spacing optimization.
